title: 第2892章 从仙品异雷入手第2891章 再回雷泽圣地
lines: “原来如此，所以你是在逃离了佛国之后，才遇到了三脉龙族。”
“真没想到，曾经的时间、空间以及光明三脉龙族原来并未彻底覆灭，反而是繁衍至今，甚至比八脉龙族更加强盛。”
“正所谓世事无常，着实让人难以预料。”
墨松涛此刻已经完全了解了这些内情，想到世事无常，自己也不由得感叹一声。
数百万年前龙凤大战还没开始的时候，人族与龙凤两族的关系还是相当不错的。
尤其是时间与空间两大龙族对于人族的态度，一直都是较为友善的。
在历史上，人族与龙族时不时还会互通有无，相互将各族弟子送到对方的势力中交流。
那段时间，整个沧玄大陆，无论人族还是妖族，都是相当舒服的。
只是后来龙凤大战开始，随着龙族各脉覆灭的覆灭，背叛的背叛，凤凰一族也就此衰弱之后，便风光不再。
后继的八脉龙族，也与人族再也不复往日的联系。
直到如今，江尘带着三位族长归来，并且诉说了曾经的内情之后，这才愕然得知了真相。
“不过照这么说，我们沧玄大陆，如今可谓是已然处于危在旦中之中。”
“无论是佛国的佛母，还是魔族的母神，虽然不知道她们的目的是什么，但毫无疑问的是，仅凭如今的人族势力绝对不是此双方的对手。”
说到此处，墨松涛满脸都是忧愁，其余长老也同样如此。
从前他们并不知道佛母与母神之事，只以为天魔一族的魔主就已经是最大的敌人。
直到如今，他们才愕然得知，曾经所认为的一切都是假的。
天魔一族早就已经拥有了足以覆灭人妖两族的实力，只是这数百万年以来一直都在出于某种目的的情况下，陪着人族玩着进犯边境慢慢蚕食的把戏。
这背后种种，着实令人细思极恐。
“难道我人族自数百万年以前就早已注定了覆灭之局？”
一位长老颇有些绝望地说道。
“其实也没有那么糟。”
敖太虚忽然说道，脸上带着笑意。
“我们三人此次之所以愿意离开小世界回到沧玄大陆，皆是因为从江尘的身上看到了希望。”
“你们可能不知道，如今的江尘可不仅仅只是你们表面看上去那么简单。”
听到这话，墨松涛顿时惊讶问道：“不知龙兄此言何意？”
他不由得看向江尘。
这小子能成功拿到古佛舍利，并将修为提升至六劫虚仙，已然十分令人惊异。
难不成还有其他事没告诉他们？
敖太虚对江尘笑道：“关于此事，就由你来告诉他们吧。”
江尘闻言点了点头，随后对着几位长老一伸手，右手上方便浮现出了一团橙红色的火焰。
相较于曾经获得过的极品异火，这团橙红色的火焰威力完全不是一个级别。
再看此火，色泽橙红之中，还颇具流光溢彩。
内里所蕴含的恐怖能量，仿佛一旦释放开来后，足以造成毁天灭地的效果。
看着此火，在场的众人顿时瞬间瞪大了眼睛，墨松涛眼中满是难以置信。
content_en:
"I see, that's why you met the Three-line Dragon Clan after escaping from the Buddhist Kingdom."
"I really didn't expect that the three-line dragon clan of time, space and light was not completely destroyed. Instead, it has multiplied to this day and is even more powerful than the eight-line dragon clan."
"As the saying goes, things in the world are unpredictable. It's really hard to predict."
Mo Songtao now fully understood the inside story, and he couldn't help but sigh when he thought about the impermanence of things in the world.
Millions of years ago, before the Dragon and Phoenix War began, the relationship between the human race and the Dragon and Phoenix tribes was quite good.
In particular, the two dragon clans of time and space have always had a friendly attitude towards the human race.
In history, the human race and the dragon race would exchange supplies from time to time, sending disciples of each race to each other's forces for exchanges.
During that time, the entire Cangxuan Continent, whether human or demonic, was quite comfortable.
It was only later that the Dragon-Phoenix War began. With the destruction of all dragon clan lines and the betrayal of betrayal, the Phoenix clan also weakened and lost its glory.
The subsequent eight-line dragon clan no longer has the same contact with the human race as before.
It was only now, after Jiang Chen returned with the three clan leaders and told the inside story, that he was shocked to learn the truth.
"But according to this, our Cangxuan Continent is now in danger."
"Whether it is the Buddha Mother of the Buddhist Kingdom or the Mother Goddess of the Demon Clan, although I don't know what their purpose is, there is no doubt that the current human power alone is definitely no match for these two parties."
Speaking of this, Mo Songtao's face was full of sorrow, and so were the other elders.
In the past, they didn't know about the Buddha Mother and the Mother Goddess. They only thought that the Demon Lord of the Demon Clan was already their biggest enemy.
It was only now that they were shocked to learn that everything they had thought was false.
The demon clan has long had the strength to destroy the human and demon clans, but for millions of years, it has been accompanying the human race to play the trick of invading the border and slowly encroaching on it for some purpose.
All the things behind this are really scary to think about.
"Could it be that our human race has been doomed to destruction millions of years ago?"
An elder said with some despair.
"It's actually not that bad."
Ao Taixu said suddenly, with a smile on his face.
"The reason why the three of us are willing to leave the small world and return to Cangxuan Continent this time is because we see hope in Jiang Chen."
"You may not know that Jiang Chen today is more than just what you seem on the surface."
Hearing this, Mo Songtao was immediately surprised and asked, "I wonder what Brother Long means by this?"
He couldn't help but look at Jiang Chen.
It is very amazing that this kid can successfully obtain the ancient Buddha relics and improve his cultivation to Six Tribulations Void Immortal.
Is there something else you haven't told them?
Ao Taixu smiled at Jiang Chen and said, "It's up to you to tell them about this matter."
Jiang Chen nodded when he heard this, then stretched out his hand towards the elders, and a ball of orange-red flame appeared on his right hand.
Compared with the top-grade alien fires that he had obtained before, the power of this orange-red flame was not at the same level at all.
Looking at this fire again, it is orange-red in color, but also quite radiant.
The terrifying energy contained within seems to be enough to cause destruction to the world once released.
Seeing the fire, everyone present immediately widened their eyes, and Mo Songtao's eyes were full of disbelief.
